name: TOTP Management Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers integration proof that the real authentication flow service, typed TOTP maintenance handlers, AppUserMfaManager, repository and secure-storage seams execute the canonical turn-off and recovery-code rotation outcomes.
notes: AuthenticationFlowService, both TOTP maintenance handlers and AppUserMfaManager are real instances in the proof harness.
IAppUserRepo and ISecureStorage are mocked as infrastructure boundaries so the proof can inspect durable-state mutations and secret operations deterministically.
Runtime execution status remains separate from this authored test binding.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical server integration evidence source for both TOTP maintenance outcomes and the enabled-factor guard.
Runner setup uses real begin/confirm enrollment operations to materialize authentic TOTP and recovery-code state.
Extracts AptixEvidence metadata from the compiled test assembly for runtime evidence generation.
